fact.claim: AWS recommends DNS validation over email validation: with Amazon Route 53 you can update records through ACM directly, and ACM automatically renews DNS-validated certificates as long as the certificate is in use and the DNS record is in place.
fact.question: Why does AWS recommend DNS validation for ACM certificates?

values.display: We recommend using DNS validation over email validation

evidence.quote: We recommend using DNS validation over email validation for the following reasons:
evidence.title: Validate domain ownership for AWS Certificate Manager public certificates

evidence.quote: If you use Amazon Route 53 to manage your public DNS records, you can update your records through ACM directly.
evidence.title: Validate domain ownership for AWS Certificate Manager public certificates

evidence.quote: ACM automatically renews DNS-validated certificates for as long as a certificate remains in use and the DNS record is in place.
evidence.title: Validate domain ownership for AWS Certificate Manager public certificates
